title: FEATURE — /blockers show RapidAPI subscription lapse warning
rationale: Sprint 1402 added RapidAPI lapse visibility to /status. /blockers is the operator's action-items view and should also surface this — pipeline is blind to new viral content when subscription lapses. Add same lapse check to cmdBlockers() auto-scan section in cmd-management.ts.

tasks.description: In scripts/telegram-commands/cmd-management.ts cmdBlockers(): after recent-errors check, add RapidAPI lapse detection that reads data/rapidapi-lapse.json and emits a blocker line when lapsed_at is within 24h TTL.
